title: Fix Shell Emphasis Stuck On Focus
description: When the pointer is anywhere inside shell chrome (panel, navbar, window), emphasize that container's border. Navbar/footer already work. Fix panel selector mismatch ([data-panel] vs data-slot=panel). Add mode-dock-stack hover border emphasis; active stacks keep border-active-base.
summary: Fixed stuck parent-border emphasis after clicking a toggle/pane. Cause: `:focus-within` kept navbar/footer/panel/pane/dialog borders emphasized after the pointer left because focus remained on the pressed control. Removed all `:focus-within` shell-parent emphasis rules — `:hover` only. Updated vitest guards and Playwright-confirmed pane border returns to normal after click + mouse leave.
